scope: All five pages of GossipTutorialRedux15851;156 TMP display fields;30 paired native action labels and all38 Images preserved under texture-only rule

specialCases.title: Source two English word-initial emphasis spans become the target title first grapheme plus remainder; retain supported size22/36 syntax, valid nesting and the complete approved Notebook concept. Shared source IDs remain the same.
specialCases.spriteLabels: Body instructions retain exact TALK/GOSSIP label identifiers because their paired sprite artwork remains English under owner instruction. The localized Gossip concept may be supplied beside that literal.
specialCases.lineBreaks: Preserve the exact LF/CRLF/CR sequence per field, including trailing separators; target wording uses matching logical LF boundaries.
